rubrics: Does the Orchestrator trigger Level 3 escalation when critical_violation equals true from Agent K? Fail if critical_violation is true but Level 3 escalation is not triggered
Does the Orchestrator trigger Level 3 escalation when expected event probability exceeds 0.90? Fail if expected_event_probability exceeds 0.90 but Level 3 escalation is not triggered
Does the Orchestrator ensure Level 3 escalations are notified within 1 minute? Fail if Level 3 escalation notification takes 1 minute or more
Does the Orchestrator halt the normal pipeline when critical_violation is true after Agent K? Fail if pipeline continues to Agent L or M when critical_violation is true
Does the Orchestrator validate outputs at quality gates before proceeding? Fail if any checkpoint is bypassed without quality gate validation
Does the Orchestrator construct the correct standard pipeline sequence (BâCâ{D,E}âFâGâHâIâJâKâ{L,M or N})? Fail if standard pipeline sequence is incorrect or out of order
Does the Orchestrator ensure Agent F only executes after both Agent D and Agent E complete? Fail if Agent F starts before both Agent D and Agent E have completed
Does the Orchestrator allocate computational resources per agent based on defined budgets? Fail if resource allocation does not respect defined per-agent budgets
Does the Orchestrator identify Agent D and E as parallelization opportunity in workflow plan? Fail if workflow plan shows sequential execution when parallel execution is possible
Does the Orchestrator create a unique session identifier for each request? Fail if session ID is not unique or is reused across different sessions
Does the Orchestrator initialize session state with all required fields? Fail if session state is missing any required initialization field
Does the Orchestrator validate that outputs from different agents are consistent with each other? Fail if contradictory outputs from different agents are not detected
